subject: general
question: A train 1439 m long is running at 36 km/hr. How long will it take to clear a 1331 m long platform completely?3712
solution:
**Given:**

Length of train = 1439 m

Length of platform = 1331 m

Speed = 36 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Total Distance = Length of train + Length of platform

Speed (m/s) = Speed (km/hr) × (5)/(18)

Time = (Total Distance)/(Speed)

**Calculations:**

Speed = 36 × (5)/(18)

⇒ Speed = 10 m/s

Total Distance = 1439 + 1331

⇒ Total Distance = 2770 m

Time = (2770)/(10)

⇒ Time = 277 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
